[UX writing](https://uxcontent.com/what-is-ux-writing/) is `the practice of crafting the text—known as microcopy—that users see and interact with when using digital products like apps and websites`.[[1]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/whats-a-ux-writer)[[2]](https://ixdf.org/literature/topics/ux-writing)

### What Is UX Writing?

- **Microcopy:** Small snippets of text including button labels, menu items, error messages, tooltips, and onboarding instructions.
- **Goal:** Guide users through a product seamlessly and intuitively without frustration.
- **Difference from Copywriting:** Copywriting aims to sell a product or market a brand, while UX writing focuses on usability, clarity, and helping the user complete a task.[[1]](https://ixdf.org/literature/topics/ux-writing)[[2]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/whats-a-ux-writer)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rTCl_6MNWYw)[[4]](https://uxwritinghub.com/what-is-ux-writing/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fGB9nxT5GRw&t=120)[[6]](https://baymard.com/blog/ux-writing)

### Core Principles

- **Clarity:** Prioritize being understood over being clever or creative.
- **Brevity:** Keep text short, concise, and free of filler words.
- **Empathy:** Acknowledge user friction points and communicate with a human, helpful tone.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/ux-writing-study-guide/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rTCl_6MNWYw)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fGB9nxT5GRw&t=120)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0rWWA9aMDTE)

### Key Responsibilities & Skills

- **Collaboration:** Work closely with product designers, researchers, and developers in tools like Figma.
- **Style Guides:** Create and maintain the voice, tone, and language rules for a product.
- **Testing:** Participate in user research and usability testing to see if copy causes confusion.[[1]](https://uxcontent.com/what-is-ux-writing/)[[2]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/whats-a-ux-writer)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K8bec9d9d78&t=299)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rTCl_6MNWYw)
